original_test_intent: Verify that the selected BMC clears only explicitly targeted pending-message status flags through the OOB command and that non-target flags, message-channel configuration and persistent diagnostic records remain intact.
original_method: The source supplies no method. Standard Clear Message Flags 0x06/0x30 is a candidate only with an exact write-one-to-clear mask derived from a captured Get Message Flags state and an approved, reproducible stimulus for each target indication.
manual_activity: Engineer chooses which pending flag is safe to consume, confirms no other management client owns the indication, approves its stimulus and one clear, and judges post-clear behavior.
required_inputs: Applicable Clear/Get Message Flags bit definitions
Timestamped pre-state from Get Message Flags
Approved target bits and write-one-to-clear byte
Method to create each target flag without clearing it prematurely
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, dmesg or syslog
Preserve raw pre-clear flags and related queue/event evidence
Never use an all-bits or guessed mask
Do not read/drain a queue merely to create a baseline
Confirm no competing consumer needs the pending indication
Treat current flag clearing as non-restorable diagnostic-state consumption
Do not retry or generate an unapproved replacement event
agent_execution_scope: Capture Get Message Flags and correlated persistent evidence
Validate that the intended stimulus produced the target bit
Show exact one-byte clear mask for approval
Read flags again and prove target-only transition
Verify Global Enables, queues and SEL/logs were not altered
engineer_actions: Define target flag and safe deterministic stimulus
Approve consumption of the pending indication
Decide response to a flag that will not clear or clears unexpectedly

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command is supplied because the Master is TBD. The standard clear operation is identifiable, but cannot be made safe without a real pre-existing target flag and exact approved mask.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After preserving `raw 0x06 0x31` pre-state and correlated evidence, send one approved `ipmitool ... raw 0x06 0x30 <clear-mask>`, then read 0x31 again; otherwise remain NOT EXECUTED.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master TBD procedure/criteria and 10/5 timing remain unchanged; no flag bit or stimulus is assumed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a transaction recorder that binds a stimulus, pre-state, W1C mask, one clear response and post-state, and refuses masks containing absent or unapproved bits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a safe, auditable candidate contract to an empty Master body and explicitly recognizes that pending-message evidence cannot generally be restored by another write.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static review does not clear any flag. Without an approved stimulus for the selected flag, command completion alone provides no meaningful functional coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Another consumer may race the test by consuming a message or changing flags. Recreating an event later is not restoration of the original pending indication or timestamp.

project_override_considerations: A vendor messaging test tool may be used when it exposes the exact flag stimulus, Get state, clear mask and queue-consumer behavior. A generic SEL-clear or message-drain function is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Approved stimulus with timestamp and resulting raw Get Message Flags pre-state
Preserved associated message/queue and SEL/log evidence
Raw post-clear flags proving only targeted pending bits changed
Unchanged Global Enables and persistent logs
Race/anomaly report with no automatic second clear

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master contains no procedure or criteria to contradict the title. Its incompleteness is preserved as a project binding gap.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The standard operation and safety boundary are identifiable. Execution waits for a specific flag, safe stimulus, ownership, mask and Expected rather than being permanently blocked.

review_improvement: Distinguishes transient write-one-to-clear message evidence from persistent logs, adds a stimulus-to-flag-to-clear proof chain, and removes the unsafe assumption that the original pending state can simply be restored.
independent_technical_reasoning: A clear-flags test is meaningful only when a known flag is asserted before the command. Clearing a zero bit proves nothing, and clearing every bit can erase evidence owned by another consumer. Because pending state can change asynchronously and is not recreated by writing it back, the evidence must bind the originating stimulus, atomic pre-state and exact target-only transition.
